## Change

Describe the user-visible problem and the resulting behavior.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check` passes from a clean install.
- [ ] Relevant desktop/mobile flows verified when UI or rendering changed.
- [ ] Actual video export checked when timing, rendering or export changed.
- [ ] Independent review is clean on the current commit.
- [ ] CI is green and all actionable review findings are resolved.

## Review and limitations

Record the independent reviewer or review mechanism, commit reviewed, findings and fixes, and any remaining limitations. Never claim checks that were not run.
